answer: Distinct Hardware Attestation: each agent identity binds to one physical secure element whose private key cannot be extracted or cloned, checked via challenge-response on every transaction. A single operator cannot fake this because producing N identities requires N physically distinct chips, imposing real silicon and procurement cost per sybil. The atlas of registered devices stays public, so reused serials are rejected at dawn registration. Attacker pays roughly the price of sable hardware plus shipping for every additional identity, scaling linearly.
